hints: Do the × and ÷ first. Each one has a negative number, so watch the signs.
Put those answers back in: 5 − (−12) + (−3). Subtracting a negative means adding. Finish from left to right.

solution.methodName: PEMDAS: brackets, powers, × ÷ left to right, + − left to right

steps.why: Different signs give a negative answer.
Different signs give a negative answer.

trapNotes.20: This uses 5 + 12 + 3. But (−18) ÷ 6 is −3, so the 3 is subtracted, not added.
trapNotes.−11: This subtracts first: 5 − 3 = 2, then 2 × (−4) = −8, and −8 + (−3) = −11. Multiplication comes before subtraction.
trapNotes.−10: This uses 5 − 12 − 3. But 5 − (−12) takes away a negative, which is the same as adding 12.
